summary: Prepare export teams to screen products, coordinate emissions evidence and map reporting workflows. Explore the practical CBAM course and enquire today.
lede: CBAM readiness training helps export, customs, finance, procurement and sustainability teams organize product-level emissions information and reporting workflows. Through practical trade exercises and templates, participants practise screening product records against customs codes, mapping supplier data gaps, reviewing emissions calculation inputs, and preparing evidence, verification questions and reporting handoffs.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage export transactions or supply the product and emissions information that CBAM-related workflows require.
modules: CBAM Readiness Dashboard and Action Plan
prerequisites: Working familiarity with export documentation, customs classification, procurement, finance, sustainability reporting or product emissions data is recommended. No programming is required. Bring a laptop with Excel access for worksheet exercises; no access to the CBAM Registry is assumed. Advanced emissions verification and legal interpretation are introduced at an operational-awareness level rather than taught as implementation specialisms.
